title: Information Systems and Knowledge Dissemination
description: A 2–3 hour course for the water sector that explains how data is collected, managed and transformed into information and knowledge, and how information systems support data-driven decisions. BONSAI is used as a practical case study of building shared knowledge across partner organisations and disseminating that knowledge to partners and the public.
integrationStatus: Content approved for later wiring into the prototype screens in KAN-53.
